accepted.quote: Committee Democrats strongly oppose H.R. 884, which would repeal a law duly enacted by the District of Columbia (D.C.) and establish a new D.C. law, because we strongly support local D.C. self-government.
accepted.rationale: The quote explicitly states strong support for local D.C. self-government and opposition to federal repeal of D.C. law.

accepted.quote: Instead of meddling in local D.C. matters, Congress should pass the D.C. statehood bill, H.R. 51, the Washington, D.C. Admission Act, which would give D.C. voting representation in Congress and full local self-government.
accepted.bill: H.R. 51, the Washington, D.C. Admission Act
accepted.rationale: The quote urges passage of D.C. statehood legislation to provide voting representation and full self-government.
